'''Nal ReulTta''' was an area of space in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]].

==History==
Reminiscent of their home world [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], the [[Borvo]] [[Kajidic/Legends|Clan]] sought to claim a small portion of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] space, a place that was eventually to be called Nal ReulTta. Borvo and his thugs found victory soon thereafter, sprouting a small outpost and guarding it from the meddlesome [[Nal Raka Criminal Empire|Empire]] with skill and bravery. The outpost stands there even today and is heavily guarded by Borvo's thugs.
